QuestInfo.name: Tigun the Guard at the Palace
QuestInfo.0: The palace of #m260000000# boasts some tight security, but you really want to go in. Talk to the head of palace security, #b#p2101004##k, for help.
QuestInfo.1: #p2101004# flat out says he can't let you in the palace...unless you show your allegiance to the Sultan by paying mesos. #b2,000 mesos#k isn't much, but you hate dealing with corrupt officials like this.
QuestInfo.2: After you gave #p2101004# 2,000 mesos, you received the pass to the palace. Even though you feel dirty about it, at least you can enter the palace now.

0.0: Hey, what are you doing snooping around the palace? This is where the Sultan of #m260000000# resides! What? You want to enter? Why would I let a traveler like you do that? No way will I let you in, unless...
0.1: If you really, really want to enter the palace, then there might be a way. You need to show your allegiance to the Sultan. How, you ask? That's easy. Just hand me #b2,000 Mesos#k. As your way of paying respect to Sultan and #m260000000#, of course.

no.0: What? You don't want to pay 2,000 Mesos? Then scram before I arrest you!
